ModMetaData.name: ZZZ Unlocked Schematics - TEST HARNESS (disable after testing)
ModMetaData.author: VitaKaninen
ModMetaData.description:
Temporary test harness for Unlocked Schematics. NOT a playable mod - disable it once the test is done.
It forces every generated schematic to draw from the seven blocklisted projects only (four Biotech mechtech, three Odyssey gravtech), turning a lucky-sample test into a binary one:
every schematic is mechtech/gravtech -> the blocklist removal worked schematics are ordinary projects -> it did not; the game fell back to the normal pool
Enable alongside Unlocked Schematics. Load order between the two does not matter.
